steps.en: Install the legacy hook — the only released code of this repo
steps.zh: 安装旧版 hook——这个仓库唯一发布过的代码
steps.code: yarn add use-select · npm i -s use-select

steps.en: Call the hook with your options, current value and change handler
steps.zh: 把选项、当前值和变更回调交给 hook
steps.code: useSelect({ multi, options, value, onChange, optionsRef })

steps.en: Tracks search text, open state and the highlighted option, and filters the options
steps.zh: 管理搜索词、展开状态和高亮项，并过滤选项

steps.en: Spread its prop getters onto your own input and option elements
steps.zh: 把它的 prop getter 展开到你自己的输入框和选项元素上

steps.en: Handles arrow/Page/Home/End/Enter/Escape/Backspace keys and outside clicks, then calls onChange
steps.zh: 处理方向键、翻页、回车、Esc、退格与外部点击，再调用 onChange

value.en: No hand-written keyboard, search and open/close state for a custom select — but only via an unmaintained 2019 React-16 hook; the TanStack rewrite has no API yet
value.zh: 不用手写键盘、搜索和开合状态——但只能靠停更的 React 16 旧 hook，重写版尚无 API

sources: README.md at commit db61b1ca (use-select era) — 'yarn add use-select' / 'npm i -s use-select', useSelect({ multi, options, value, onChange, optionsRef }), {...getInputProps()}, getOptionProps(...)
src/index.js on branch old — useSelect options, getKeyProps key map (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End/Enter/Escape/Tab/Backspace), getOptionProps error text 'getOptionProps({index: 1})'
packages/select/src/index.ts on main — current core is the placeholder `export const select = 'select'`
issue #30 (2026-08-05) — RFC for the rewrite; issue #29 comment by KevinVandy (2025-05-15) — use-select practically deprecated
